tasks.name: 创建笔记数据库模型
创建笔记API路由
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags; use an ORM like Sequelize or Mongoose for implementation.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for efficient search and retrieval.

T2.implementation_approach: Set up RESTful API routes for CRUD operations using a framework like Express; include endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.
T2.notes: Implement input validation and error handling for robust API functionality.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop a responsive frontend using a framework like React or Vue; include forms for creating/editing notes and a list view for displaying them.
T3.notes: Ensure seamless integration with the API and implement basic UI/UX principles.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search feature on the backend using query parameters to filter notes by title, content, or tags; update the frontend to include a search bar.
T4.notes: Optimize search queries for performance, especially for large datasets.
